# Lab 3.9: Export Data

## What We Are Going to Do
Export query results and tables to Cloud Storage with `EXPORT DATA`, extract jobs and the console, using different formats and compression.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Export query results as Parquet.** Replace `YOUR_BUCKET`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (
  uri = 'gs://YOUR_BUCKET/exports/shakespeare/part-*.parquet',
  format = 'PARQUET',
  compression = 'SNAPPY',
  overwrite = TRUE
) AS
SELECT corpus, SUM(word_count) AS words
FROM `bigquery-public-data.samples.shakespeare`
GROUP BY corpus;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Export a whole table as gzip CSV.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">export BUCKET=$PROJECT_ID-bq-labs
bq extract --destination_format=CSV --compression=GZIP --print_header=true \
  lab03.names_parquet "gs://$BUCKET/exports/names/names-*.csv.gz"
gcloud storage ls -l gs://$BUCKET/exports/names/</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   A wildcard is required when the export is larger than **1 GB**, because each file holds at most 1 GB.

3. **[Console] Export from the UI.** Open `lab03.stores → Export → Export to GCS`. Choose JSON format and a path in your bucket.

4. **[CLI] Check the files.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage ls -r gs://$BUCKET/exports/
gcloud storage cat gs://$BUCKET/exports/names/names-000000000000.csv.gz | gunzip | head -5</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `EXPORT DATA` | Exports any query result |
| `bq extract` | Exports a table |
| Formats | CSV, JSON, Avro, Parquet |
| Large exports | Need a `*` wildcard in the path |
